title: Young Hands at Work
text:
Many teenagers now look for part-time jobs while they are still at school. Some work in cafés or shops, and others help with online tutoring. Earning their own money teaches them to manage time and to value what they buy.

Volunteering is another way for young people to gain experience. Local charities often welcome students who can help at food banks or animal shelters. Experts believe that such work builds confidence, although some worry that too many hours can hurt school results.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, where do some teenagers work?
According to paragraph two, where can students help as volunteers?
options: At food banks or animal shelters

questions.text: Why might earning their own money help teenagers learn to manage their time?
options: They must plan work around school and their spending
Their teachers give them extra homework
Employers only hire them for night shifts
Their parents stop setting any rules at home

questions.text: What can be inferred about the author's view of working too many hours?
options: The author sees it as a possible risk to school performance
The author believes it always improves grades
The author recommends working every day of the week
The author has no opinion about it

vocabulary.definition: for fewer hours than a full working week
working for free to help others
organizations that raise money or help people in need
a belief in your own abilities

paragraph_translations: Birçok genç, hâlâ okuldayken yarı zamanlı iş aramaktadır. Bazıları kafelerde veya dükkânlarda çalışır, bazıları ise çevrim içi destek derslerinde yardımcı olur. Kendi parasını kazanmak, gençlere zamanlarını yönetmeyi ve satın aldıkları şeylerin değerini bilmeyi öğretir.

Gönüllü çalışmak, gençlerin deneyim kazanmasının bir başka yoludur. Yerel hayır kurumları, gıda bankalarında veya hayvan barınaklarında yardım edebilecek öğrencileri sıklıkla memnuniyetle karşılar. Uzmanlar bu tür çalışmaların özgüveni geliştirdiğine inanıyor, ancak bazıları çok fazla çalışma saatinin okul başarısına zarar verebileceğinden endişe ediyor.
